verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own docs cite a 'full Ubuntu terminal environment' (also via WSL) for running AI/ML tooling, and a help topic on changing the default terminal. That shows an official command-line environment exists, but the evidence never describes a dedicated official CLI tool or its commands, and nothing ties it to AI-native or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: a documented official CLI with a command reference, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI capabilities (structured output, automation hooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
